newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean bond market closed for national holiday.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean bond market closed for national holiday.

text.p: The South Korean bond market is closed on Thursday for National Foundation Day holiday and will reopen on Friday, dealers said.

On Wednesday, yields on both benchmark three-year corporate bonds and three-month CDs closed lower on lack of substantial transactions, dealers said. They forecast the yields would remain weak in the rest of this week without specific demand.
* 3-yr corporates end at 12.30 pct vs Tuesday's 12.35 pct
* Overnight average call rates at 16.5 vs 18.0
